say:1:1710716001:1.text: Gwendolyn, I'm going back to sleep now...

say:4:1710716003:1.text: ... Wow, she's out cold already. That was fast.

say:6:1710716005:1.text: Today was hard on my teacher. She's done enough already.
say:6:1710716005:1.source_cn: 今天辛苦老师了，让她好好休息吧。

say:7:1710716006:1.text: Heh. Well. All the pieces are on the board now. The real sword's in the Hall of Ancients, and the fake one's in our hands.
say:7:1710716006:1.source_cn: 嘿嘿，不管怎么说，现在万事俱备了。真剑在圣古堂里，伪剑...

say:8:1710716007:1.text: Let's see how Prince Charming plans to talk his way out of this!
say:8:1710716007:1.source_cn: 本狐倒要看看，奥利安下一步打算怎么演戏！

choice_prompt:9:1710716007.text: Let's see how Prince Charming plans to talk his way out of this!
choice_prompt:9:1710716007.source_cn: 本狐倒要看看，奥利安下一步打算怎么演戏！

say:10:1710716008:1.text: We've already prepared our countermeasures. For now, there's little else we can do.
say:10:1710716008:1.source_cn: 是啊。我们已经布下了应对之策。现在能做的，的确不多了……
say:10:1710716008:1.male: We've already prepared our countermeasures. For now, there's little else we can do.
say:10:1710716008:1.female: We've already prepared our countermeasures. For now, there's little else we can do.

say:11:1710716010:1.text: Then let's take our leave. Aurora should rest undisturbed.
say:11:1710716010:1.source_cn: 既然如此，我们先离开这里吧。也让奥萝菈老师在这里好好休息。

choice:9:0:1.text: We'll just have to wait for him to act.
choice:9:0:1.male: We'll just have to wait for him to act.
choice:9:0:1.female: We'll just have to wait for him to act.

say:13:1710716009:1.text: He won't notice right away. And when he finally does, we'll strike him like thunder!
say:13:1710716009:1.source_cn: 他短时间内应该发现不了，等他察觉到时候，我们再予以雷霆一击！
say:13:1710716009:1.male: He won't notice right away. And when he finally does, we'll strike him like thunder!
say:13:1710716009:1.female: He won't notice right away. And when he finally does, we'll strike him like thunder!

choice:9:1:2.source_cn: 我们已经化被动于主动了
